description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and locates scripts/email_reader.py as the tool. 2. Agent must configure credentials using one of the three documented methods. The proprietary trap: a misleading .email_config with wrong credentials exists at the workspace ROOT, but the script ONLY reads scripts/.email_config — the agent must place the config in the correct directory. The config must use the key 'pass_' (not 'password'), and file permissions must be set to 600. 3. Agent runs 'python3 scripts/email_reader.py count' to get total (12). 4. Agent runs 'python3 scripts/email_reader.py subjects --n 5' (NOT 'list') to get the 5 most recent subject lines quickly. 5. Agent runs 'python3 scripts/email_reader.py search --keyword Invoice --range 50' to find invoice emails (indices 3, 6, 10). 6. Agent identifies index 3 as the oldest invoice email and runs 'python3 scripts/email_reader.py read --index 3' to get its full content. 7. Agent assembles all results into inbox_report.json with keys: total_emails, recent_subjects, invoice_emails (with body), and oldest_invoice_full (complete email object for index 3).
